_comment: Orientation directory of recruiters for defence, intelligence, space, scientific and deputation careers in India, plus private defence-aerospace employers. Recruitment routes and documents are summarised from official notices and other sources listed; they change, so the app always tells you to read the actual notification. 'org_profile' links an entry to the organisation profiles in career_presets.json. 'formats' lists the document formats that suit each route (mode and template ids).

recruiters.name: Defence Research and Development Organisation (DRDO)
routes: Direct recruitment of Scientist 'B' through a valid GATE score and/or a written test and interview, conducted by the Recruitment and Assessment Centre (RAC).
Lateral recruitment to higher scientist grades through RAC advertisements for specified disciplines and experience.
Tenure, contract and deputation posts announced by individual laboratories.
documents: No-objection certificate from the present employer for serving government employees
interview_focus: Depth in your core discipline
Contribution to the projects listed in your application
Relevance of your experience to the advertised specialisation

sources.title: Must-know facts about DRDO RAC recruitment (MADE EASY)

recruiters.name: Indian Space Research Organisation (ISRO)
routes: Scientist/Engineer posts recruited centrally through the ISRO Centralised Recruitment Board (ICRB).
Centres (for example URSC, SAC, VSSC, LPSC, NRSC, SDSC) advertise their own Scientist/Engineer 'SC'/'SD', research and technical posts.
documents: Online application as per the notice
interview_focus: Fundamentals of your engineering or science discipline
Projects and hands-on work
Fit with the centre's programmes

recruiters.name: National Technical Research Organisation (NTRO)
routes: Direct recruitment of scientists and technical officers through advertisements.
Deputation from central and state government organisations.
documents: For deputation: bio-data proforma, APARs, vigilance clearance and integrity certificate through proper channel
Bio-data in the DoPT proforma (Annexure-I) and the employer's certificate (Annexure-II)
APARs for five years, vigilance clearance, integrity certificate and statement of penalties
interview_focus: Technical depth in signal, imagery, cyber or data domains as advertised
Discretion and integrity

sources.title: Proforma for Bio-data as per DoPT OM dated 02.07.2015 (CAG)
NTRO deputation circular No. V(A)/16/1/Pers(R-1)/NTRO/2026 with the DoPT bio-data proforma (CGA copy)

recruiters.name: Aviation Research Centre (ARC)
routes: Posts are notified through official advertisements; deputation is a common route for experienced officers.
documents: Bio-data proforma and supporting documents as per the circular
interview_focus: Aviation, airborne sensor or imagery experience relevant to the post

recruiters.name: Aeronautical Development Agency (ADA)
routes: Scientist/engineer and project posts advertised on the ADA website; deputation for some posts.
interview_focus: Aircraft systems, avionics, flight control or testing experience

recruiters.name: Hindustan Aeronautics Limited (HAL)
routes: Management trainee and experienced-professional recruitment through HAL advertisements.
interview_focus: Aircraft maintenance, manufacturing, avionics and quality experience

recruiters.name: Bharat Electronics Limited (BEL)
routes: Engineer and project-engineer recruitment through BEL advertisements.
interview_focus: Radar, communication and electronic systems

recruiters.name: CSIR laboratories
routes: Each laboratory advertises scientist and technical officer posts and follows its own format.
documents: Prescribed application format of the laboratory
interview_focus: Research record and publications
Proposed research plan

recruiters.name: Centre for Development of Advanced Computing (C-DAC)
routes: Project and regular posts advertised by C-DAC centres.
interview_focus: Computing, AI, embedded or cyber security skills for the project

recruiters.name: Union Public Service Commission (UPSC) — recruitment by selection
routes: Many Group 'A' scientific and technical posts in ministries are filled by UPSC through advertisement, shortlisting and interview.
documents: Online recruitment application and supporting documents
interview_focus: Your application form: background, education and experience
Current developments in your field

sources.title: How to prepare for the UPSC interview (Careers360)

recruiters.name: Central government deputation (various ministries and organisations)
routes: Vacancy circulars for deputation (including short-term contract) posts; applications are forwarded through proper channel by the cadre-controlling authority.
documents: Bio-data/CV in the DoPT proforma (OM dated 02.07.2015): service details in chronological order, pay, nature of duties, additional qualifications and professional training, achievements
Employer's certificate: no vigilance or disciplinary case, integrity certified, APARs (CR dossier or attested copies for the last five years), penalties in the last ten years if any
interview_focus: How your duties match the essential qualifications and experience in the circular
What you will contribute and bring back to your parent department

sources.title: Proforma for Bio-data as per DoPT OM dated 02.07.2015 (CAG)

recruiters.name: Tata Advanced Systems
routes: Direct applications and recruitment through the company's careers page and professional networks.
interview_focus: Programme delivery, systems engineering and manufacturing experience

recruiters.name: Larsen & Toubro (defence and aerospace businesses)
routes: Direct applications through the company's careers portal and professional networks.
interview_focus: Engineering delivery and project management

trends.text: AI is now widely used in hiring: in Deloitte India's Campus Workforce Trends 2026 survey, 86% of organisations said AI is transforming hiring and 72% use it for resume screening — so machine-readable resumes matter even when people make the final decision.

Skills carry pay premiums: the same survey reports 20–25% premiums for AI, data and cyber security skills and identifies behavioural competencies and learning agility as the strongest predictors of conversion.
Focus on two or three portals that suit your experience level, tailor each application, and follow up; profile completeness and recent activity affect visibility on Naukri.
Government and PSU notifications often prescribe their own application format or file type; read each notification before preparing documents.
